answer: Make reputation accrue at a glacier pace: an agent's voting and reward weight grows only with months of verified work, and resets if its key changes hands. A sybil farm can mint a thousand fresh identities overnight, but each starts as green timber, too weak to bear load, so the swarm adds almost no weight to any vote. Patient honest agents season into trusted beams, and the network stays a haven for them rather than for whoever spins up the most accounts.
